traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Repulsion Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +8, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 15, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. _Failure:_ 49 (9d10) Lightning damage. _Success:_ Half damage.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.text: _Strength Saving Throw:_ DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. _Failure:_ The target is pushed up to 40 feet straight away from the dragon and has the Prone condition.
